metadata.description: Partial audit checklist for remaining properties (batch 2 of iterative generation)

checklist.title: Verify deterministic rejection for values exceeding 2^248-1
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate _afterTokenTransfer hook in zERC20.sol
2. Verify MAX_VALUE constant is defined as 2^248 - 1
3. Confirm value > MAX_VALUE check is strictly enforced with no conditional bypasses
4. Verify ValueTooLarge error is reverted for oversized values
5. Check all code paths into _afterTokenTransfer enforce this validation
6. Ensure validation occurs before any hash chain updates

executable_checks.assertion: MAX_VALUE constant and ValueTooLarge error are defined
No conditional bypasses exist for value validation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-TRANSFER-REJECTED-VALUE-TOO-LARGE -> Node STATE-TRANSFER-REJECTED-VALUE-TOO-LARGE. This check ensures BN254 field bounds are enforced to maintain ZK circuit compatibility.

checklist.title: Verify Verifier maintains clean stateless validation between proof attempts
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify proof validation functions are stateless with respect to previous calls
2. Confirm only persistent mappings are provedTransferRoots and globalTransferRoots
3. Check no local state carries over between validation calls
4. Verify failed validations leave no residual state
5. Ensure each validation is independent and atomic

executable_checks.assertion: Only authorized persistent state mappings exist

executable_checks.command: Review proveTransferRoot and teleport for state isolation
executable_checks.assertion: Each validation is independent with no cross-contamination
Failed validation does not affect subsequent validations

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-VERIFIER-IDLE -> Node STATE-VERIFIER-IDLE. Ensures Verifier maintains clean state between operations to prevent validation bypass through state manipulation.

checklist.title: Verify checkpoint reservation creates immutable binding between index and hash chain
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate reserveHashChain function in Verifier.sol
2. Verify reservedHashChains[index] is write-once (no update after initial write)
3. Confirm checkpoint queries current zERC20 state at call time
4. Verify no administrative function can modify reserved checkpoints
5. Check HashChainReserved event emission matches storage
6. Ensure checkpoint cannot be created for non-existent indices

executable_checks.assertion: reservedHashChains mapping exists with write-once semantics
Reserve function exists and is properly gated
Once reserved, checkpoint cannot be modified

executable_checks.command: Verify no setter exists for reservedHashChains

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-VERIFIER-RESERVE-HASH-CHAIN -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-RESERVE-HASH-CHAIN. Critical for ensuring proof verification anchors to correct on-chain state.

checklist.title: Verify HashChainReserved event accurately reflects stored checkpoint data
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate HashChainReserved event definition
2. Verify event parameters match stored checkpoint fields
3. Confirm event emission uses same values as storage write
4. Check event and storage occur in same transaction atomically
5. Verify no code paths emit event without corresponding storage

executable_checks.assertion: Event defined and emitted with checkpoint data

executable_checks.command: Verify event parameters match storage write values

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-HASH-CHAIN-RESERVED -> Node STATE-HASH-CHAIN-RESERVED. Ensures off-chain indexers see accurate checkpoint data.

checklist.title: Verify transfer root proof submission requires prior checkpoint reservation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate proveTransferRoot function in Verifier.sol
2. Verify function checks reservedHashChains[index] != empty before accepting proof
3. Confirm proof for unreserved index causes revert
4. Check error message identifies missing checkpoint
5. Verify no bypass path allows proof without checkpoint

executable_checks.assertion: Checkpoint lookup exists in proof validation
Proof submission without prior checkpoint reverts

executable_checks.command: Trace proveTransferRoot entry to checkpoint validation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-AWAITING-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROOF -> Node STATE-AWAITING-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROOF. Ensures proof verification anchors to correct on-chain state.

checklist.title: Verify cryptographic proof validation via IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof()
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Nova proof verification call in proveTransferRoot
2. Verify IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof() is called with correct parameters
3. Confirm Groth16 verifier uses correct verification key
4. Check proof verification occurs BEFORE any state changes
5. Verify invalid proofs cause revert with appropriate error
6. Ensure verification key cannot be modified after deployment

executable_checks.assertion: No unauthorized token transfers before proof verification

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-NOVA-PROOF -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-NOVA-PROOF. Core cryptographic security - 128-bit Groth16 soundness guarantees computational infeasibility of proof forgery.

checklist.title: Verify transfer root storage requires successful cryptographic proof verification
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Trace all paths to provedTransferRoots storage
2. Verify all paths pass through cryptographic verification
3. Confirm no administrative bypass function exists
4. Check provedTransferRoots cannot be directly set
5. Verify event emission only after successful proof and storage
6. Ensure no initializer or constructor can set roots

executable_checks.assertion: Only one write location after verification

executable_checks.command: Map all code paths to provedTransferRoots write

executable_checks.assertion: Roots stored only after valid proof

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED -> Node STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED. Ensures transfer root integrity through cryptographic proof gating.

checklist.title: Verify emergency state triggers only on divergent proofs for same index
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate emergency trigger logic in proveTransferRoot
2. Verify trigger requires: provedTransferRoots[index] != 0 AND newRoot != existingRoot
3. Confirm both conditions require valid cryptographic proofs
4. Check emergency cannot be triggered maliciously without valid proofs
5. Verify emergency flag blocks relevant operations
6. Ensure emergency recovery path exists via verifier rotation

executable_checks.assertion: Emergency state and trigger logic exist
Emergency triggers only with valid divergent proofs
Both conditions require valid proofs - no malicious trigger

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-EMERGENCY-TRIGGERED -> Node STATE-EMERGENCY-TRIGGERED. Emergency detection is security-critical - false positives could halt protocol, false negatives could allow invalid state.

checklist.title: Verify teleport request enforces all required parameter presence
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate teleport/withdrawWithProof function signature
2. Verify all required parameters are in function signature
3. Confirm Solidity ABI encoding enforces parameter presence
4. Check no optional parameters that could allow incomplete requests
5. Verify parameter types match expected values

executable_checks.assertion: Teleport function with complete parameter list

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-AWAITING-TELEPORT-PROOF -> Node STATE-AWAITING-TELEPORT-PROOF. Ensures malformed requests cannot bypass validation logic.

checklist.title: Verify root reference validation against provedTransferRoots or globalTransferRoots
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate root reference validation in teleport/withdraw function
2. Verify local roots checked against provedTransferRoots[root.index] == root.value
3. Verify cross-chain roots checked against globalTransferRoots[aggSeq]
4. Confirm unknown/zero roots cause revert
5. Check no default value can bypass validation
6. Verify root validation occurs before other checks
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-ROOT-REFERENCE -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-ROOT-REFERENCE. First layer of teleport validation - ensures claims reference proven state.

checklist.title: Verify recipient hash binding prevents proof theft via msg.sender derivation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate recipient hash computation in teleport function
2. Verify formula: recipientHash = Poseidon(chain_id, msg.sender, tweak)
3. Confirm msg.sender is used (not user-provided address)
4. Check hash is computed on-chain and compared to proof public input
5. Verify different sender produces different hash (collision resistance)
6. Check tweak prevents cross-chain replay

executable_checks.assertion: Proof cannot be used by different sender
Recipient hash uniquely binds to msg.sender

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH. Poseidon collision resistance ensures User A cannot claim User B's proof.

checklist.title: Verify strict monotonicity of totalTeleported prevents double-spend
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate totalTeleported check in teleport function
2. Verify check is newTotal > currentTotal (strictly greater, not >=)
3. Confirm totalTeleported update occurs BEFORE minting
4. Check proof replay fails because newTotal <= currentTotal
5. Verify totalTeleported is per-recipient mapping
6. Ensure no overflow in totalTeleported accumulation

executable_checks.assertion: newTotal must be strictly greater than current

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-VERIFIER-CHECK-MONOTONICITY -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-CHECK-MONOTONICITY. PRIMARY double-spend prevention - most critical financial security check.

checklist.title: Verify cryptographic validation of withdrawal proof before minting
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Groth16 verification call in teleport function
2. Verify proof verification uses correct verification key
3. Confirm verification occurs BEFORE any token minting
4. Check public inputs include all critical values
5. Verify invalid proofs cause immediate revert
6. Ensure verification key matches off-chain circuit

executable_checks.command: Verify proof verification precedes mint call
executable_checks.assertion: No tokens minted before proof verified

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF. 128-bit Groth16 soundness prevents forged withdrawal proofs.

checklist.title: Verify mint amount exactly matches proof-authorized delta
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate zERC20.teleport() call in Verifier
2. Verify delta is extracted directly from verified proof public inputs
3. Confirm no modification between proof extraction and mint call
4. Check delta = newTotal - previousTotal from proof
5. Verify teleport function mints exactly the passed amount
6. Ensure no intermediate calculations can alter amount

executable_checks.assertion: Teleport call with delta from proof

executable_checks.command: Trace delta from proof extraction to mint call

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-VERIFIER-CALL-TELEPORT -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-CALL-TELEPORT. Ensures economic invariant - users receive exactly what proofs authorize.

checklist.title: Verify teleport completion requires all four validation layers to pass
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Map teleport function control flow
2. Verify sequential validation: root -> recipient -> monotonicity -> proof
3. Confirm each validation reverts on failure (not just returns false)
4. Check Teleported event only emits after successful zERC20.teleport()
5. Verify no early exit paths skip validations
6. Ensure all four checks are mandatory (not optional)

executable_checks.command: Review teleport control flow for validation order

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE -> Node STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE. Multi-layer defense - each layer catches different attack vectors.

checklist.title: Verify failed teleport results in clean rejection with no tokens minted
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify all validation failures cause revert
2. Confirm no state changes persist on revert
3. Check no tokens are minted before validations complete
4. Verify totalTeleported is not updated on failure
5. Ensure user funds are not stuck on failure
6. Check appropriate error messages for each failure type

executable_checks.assertion: No state changes on failed teleport

executable_checks.command: Verify all validations use revert (not return false)

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-TELEPORT-REJECTED -> Node STATE-TELEPORT-REJECTED. Atomicity ensures no partial minting on any validation failure.

checklist.title: Verify only cryptographically proven roots can be relayed to Hub
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate relayTransferRoot function in Verifier.sol
2. Verify function reads root from provedTransferRoots mapping
3. Confirm provedTransferRoots only populated after successful verification
4. Check no alternate path to relay unproven roots
5. Verify LayerZero _lzSend call uses correct parameters
6. Ensure message format matches Hub expectation

executable_checks.assertion: Relay reads from proven roots mapping

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-VERIFIER-RELAY-ROOT -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-RELAY-ROOT. Ensures Hub only receives cryptographically validated roots.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-ROOT-RELAYED confirms successful LayerZero message submission
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify _lzSend call follows LayerZero OApp pattern
2. Confirm _lzSend reverts on submission failure
3. Check RootRelayed event only emits after successful _lzSend
4. Verify event parameters match sent message
5. Ensure no success indication on failed submission

executable_checks.assertion: LayerZero send and event emission exist

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-ROOT-RELAYED -> Node STATE-ROOT-RELAYED. Ensures accurate tracking of cross-chain message submission.

checklist.title: Verify Hub accepts cross-chain messages only from registered Verifiers
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate _lzReceive function in Hub.sol
2. Verify source EID validation against registered Verifier EIDs
3. Confirm unregistered EIDs cause revert
4. Check Verifier registration is admin-controlled
5. Verify no bypass path for EID validation
6. Ensure LayerZero OApp pattern correctly implemented

executable_checks.command: Review Verifier registration and EID validation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-HUB-IDLE -> Node STATE-HUB-IDLE. Ensures Hub maintains security boundary against unauthorized cross-chain messages.

checklist.title: Verify Hub validates sender EID matches registered Verifier for claimed token
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify Hub maintains tokenInfo[tokenIndex].verifierEid mapping
2. Confirm received message EID checked against registered verifierEid
3. Check message for wrong token rejected
4. Verify Verifier cannot send roots for other tokens
5. Ensure proper token identification in message

executable_checks.assertion: Verifier can only submit for registered token

executable_checks.command: Review tokenInfo mapping and EID validation logic

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-HUB-RECEIVE-ROOT -> Node ACTION-HUB-RECEIVE-ROOT. Relies on LayerZero guardian supermajority (13/19) for cross-chain message authenticity.
